selection.reason: RC53's exact continuation point requested a large same-lot source with common EOL, replicated regimes, and an early repeated diagnostic. KIT provides 228 HG2 cells, 76 triplicate conditions, four temperatures, repeated capacity/EIS/pulse check-ups, and almost 600 days of results. Holding all 57 cells at 40 degrees creates a direct, falsifiable temperature-transfer test.

precommit.chronology: Configuration and column definitions were inspected before afd9301; no EOC, EIS, or pulse result value was opened. Four zero-weight pilots then fixed sd_block_id and capacity-anchor mapping before 4ceb79d; no non-pilot result file was opened before that commit.

newlyVerifiedFacts: The official version-2 EOC, EIS, and pulse archives match all three preregistered MD5 values.
The configuration contains 228 cells in 76 triplicate conditions, split evenly into 57 cells at each of 0, 10, 25, and 40 degrees Celsius.
All 57 held-temperature cells have a resolvable CU1-to-terminal capacity endpoint; 46 reach the registered 80% EOL and 11 are right censored.
Thirteen target cells lack at least one registered CU0-to-CU1 EIS response, leaving 44 common complete targets and 36 observed events.
The common complete development cohort contains 156 cells: all 35 calendar cells are censored, while 89 of 97 cyclic and all 24 profile cells reach EOL.
Arm A has MdAE 226.22 days, Harrell concordance 0.8476, within-condition concordance 0.500, and maximum calibration error 0.2280.
Arm B lowers pooled MdAE to 166.53 days and raises concordance to 0.8632, but calendar MdAE worsens from 10,533 to 12,725 days.
Arm C worsens MdAE to 298.45 days, within-condition concordance to 0.4074, and maximum calibration error to 0.2834.
Arm D recovers pooled MdAE to 240.46 days but reaches only 0.5185 within-condition concordance over 27 pairs and 0.2710 maximum calibration error.
The D-versus-C pooled MdAE improvement is 19.43%, but the 2,000-condition-bootstrap 95% interval spans -82.57% to 36.14%.
H0, H1, H2, and H3 are all rejected under their frozen joint gates.
Two independent runtimes agree across 850 shared deterministic values with maximum absolute difference 1.1817e-8.

evidenceInferenceProposalBoundary.confirmed: Cohort completeness, events and censoring, all registered arm metrics, all rejected verdicts, archive hashes, and independent numerical agreement.
evidenceInferenceProposalBoundary.inference: The absence of development calendar EOL events makes the 40-degree calendar acceleration weakly identified; high pooled rank with poor within-condition order shows condition recognition without reliable cell-frailty recovery.
evidenceInferenceProposalBoundary.proposal: A low-dimensional hierarchical longitudinal-frailty model using one preregistered capacity or 30%-SOC pulse response should be tested only on a new unopened endpoint source.

hypotheses.reason: Stress-only misses the 75-day MdAE, family, calibration, and within-condition boundaries despite high pooled concordance.
Static diagnostics reduce pooled MdAE 26.39% but increase worst-family error, so their apparent benefit does not transport across calendar aging.
One-week capacity response worsens MdAE by 79.21% relative to B and worsens calibration.

The full perturbation response lacks complete target coverage, misses the 60-day error and 0.60 within-condition gates, has only 27 comparable pairs, fails family and calibration gates, and has an uncertainty interval crossing zero.

mostPromisingPath.status: exploratory signal requiring an independent prospective source; not established as novel or validated
mostPromisingPath.hypothesis: A single low-noise early capacity or 30%-SOC 10 ms pulse response estimates within-condition frailty, while the full longitudinal capacity history estimates the condition-level degradation law under censoring.
mostPromisingPath.differenceFromFailedApproach: RC54 placed sixteen response coordinates directly into one global AFT extrapolation. The next design separates condition-level trajectory from cell-level rank, uses censored pre-EOL paths from calendar cells, and limits the frailty channel to one or two frozen measurements with explicit missingness and abstention.
mostPromisingPath.firstTest: On a new unopened source, require at least 90% feature coverage and within-condition concordance above 0.60 over at least 30 comparable EOL pairs before fitting any absolute-life model.
mostPromisingPath.success: Only after the rank gate passes, require held-condition magnitude and calibration gates plus an independent implementation.
mostPromisingPath.stop: If coverage or within-condition ordering fails, stop adding electrochemical features and move to pressure, expansion, acoustic, thermal, or mechanical sensing.

workPackages.method: Publish all 57 target endpoint statuses, the 13 diagnostic-missing cells, common 44-cell predictions, family errors, calibration, and rejected gates.
workPackages.deliverable: Versioned table, two fit implementations, independent audit, and boundary diagnostic.
workPackages.pass: Every reported denominator and prediction is machine-verifiable.
workPackages.failure: Any silent row removal, outcome-aware imputation, or verdict mismatch reopens the cycle.
workPackages.next: Use this fixed record as a negative benchmark.

workPackages.purpose: Separate condition law from cell frailty
workPackages.method: Fit a monotone or mechanism-constrained longitudinal capacity trajectory to all pre-EOL check-ups, with condition effects separate from a single early-response frailty term.
workPackages.deliverable: A preregistered two-level likelihood and identifiability audit.
workPackages.pass: Calendar censoring contributes trajectory information without fabricated EOL labels.
workPackages.failure: If condition and frailty remain non-identifiable, do not produce life predictions.
workPackages.next: Add an orthogonal sensor or new temperature arm.

workPackages.method: Predefine valid-spectrum acquisition and missingness reasons; measure coverage before outcomes and allow abstention rather than complete-case optimism.
workPackages.pass: At least 90% target coverage and 30 comparable within-condition pairs.
workPackages.failure: Coverage below threshold rejects the modality before modeling.
workPackages.next: Prefer pulse or capacity coordinates that remain observable.

workPackages.method: Search an external same-chemistry or carefully mapped NMC/C-SiO source with replicated conditions, repeated early capacity/pulse measurements, and common EOL. Freeze the one- or two-coordinate frailty rule before opening outcomes.
workPackages.deliverable: Outcome-sealed manifest, source mapping, and preregistration commit.
workPackages.pass: The source supports 30 comparable pairs, a held condition, censoring, and independent adjudication.
workPackages.failure: Do not reuse the now-open KIT 40-degree cohort as confirmation.
workPackages.next: If no public source qualifies, publish the missing benchmark specification instead of claiming progress.

uncertaintyBudget.risk: Thirteen target cells lack a registered early EIS response and pulse/EIS rows contain repeated raw samples.
uncertaintyBudget.control: Use sd_block_id, capacity-anchor windows, explicit validity flags, and exact missing fields.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: No imputation or complete-case claim of full coverage.

uncertaintyBudget.risk: One global Weibull shape and linear log-scale law extrapolate into an unobserved temperature.
uncertaintyBudget.control: Report family boundaries, calibration, within-condition rank, and an independent score-equation solution.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: High pooled concordance cannot rescue magnitude or calibration failure.

uncertaintyBudget.risk: All cells share one commercial model and purchase batch; only three replicates occupy each condition.
uncertaintyBudget.control: Bootstrap by condition and require a new source for confirmation.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: No chemistry, laboratory, pack, or field generalization.

uncertaintyBudget.risk: No development calendar cell reaches 80% EOL, so 40-degree calendar life is extrapolated from censored paths.
uncertaintyBudget.control: Preserve right censoring and promote longitudinal-path modeling rather than fabricated thresholds.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Do not claim a calendar acceleration law from this fit.

uncertaintyBudget.risk: The 30%-SOC pulse and capacity rank signals were found after outcomes opened.
uncertaintyBudget.control: Label them exploratory and test them only in a new unopened source.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: They cannot rescue RC54 or serve as independent validation on KIT.

failedRuns.failure: PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest and Windows curl failed TLS credential acquisition.
failedRuns.resolution: Anaconda requests downloaded the same official URLs; all three files then matched preregistered MD5 hashes.

failedRuns.failure: Grouping pulse rows by exact timestamp would treat millisecond waveform samples as separate measurements.
failedRuns.resolution: The zero-weight pilot identified sd_block_id as the measurement key before any non-pilot file was opened; amendment 01 was committed.

failedRuns.failure: A stricter SciPy BFGS tolerance reported precision loss, and initial independent extreme predictions differed by 0.0482 days.
failedRuns.resolution: Preserved the attempt in a solver note, used a documented BFGS stopping tolerance, and independently polished the same analytic score equations.
failedRuns.scientificEffect: no verdict changed; final maximum difference is 1.1817e-8

newConnection.summary: RUL, process twins, and accelerated qualification share a two-level identifiability problem: condition-level trajectories and specimen-level frailty must be separated under censoring and an incomplete observation operator.

nextCycleStart: Do not tune another model on the opened KIT 40-degree outcomes. First locate or specify a new replicated NMC/C-SiO EOL source. Before outcome access, freeze one capacity-response and at most one 30%-SOC 10 ms pulse-response frailty coordinate, a longitudinal condition model, missingness and abstention rules, at least 90% target coverage, at least 30 comparable within-condition pairs, one complete held condition, calibration thresholds, and an independent solver. If no source meets this denominator, publish the benchmark gap and move to an orthogonal mechanical modality.
